meaning: Review gates are unresolved evidence requirements, not implementation, permission or native execution results.

gates.scope: Independent outer-line inspection and distinct outer/child length overloads; never outline fallback
gates.reason: One own-fixture real GetPatternLineInfo observed status success, 4 lines, documented fields only and absolute API-mm coordinates; a follow-up matched 4/4 two-argument GetLineLength values (delta 0.0). Live reads of five curved/straight pieces show length_mm arc-like (>chord) and mid_mm as the endpoint midpoint; orientation is a dominant-axis label, not a direction vector. A move [25,-30] shifted every coordinate exactly and kept lengths/norm unchanged (frame after move established). Rotation/scale, independent arc measurement and sanitized failure variants remain unverified. The get_pattern_lines tool performs this bounded read; per-overload coverage stays planned/not_tested. Presence and samples are not full native acceptance.
required_evidence: Exact overload IDs and RealPatternList/outer-line/child namespaces kept separate
Sanitized failure/malformed/partial variants and repeated-read stability beyond observed samples
Separate own-fixture line-info gate before outer-length calls; no outline calls, mutations, retry or 3-argument fallback
Independent arc-length measurement and rotation/scale frame evidence before normalized claims; move-invariance and arc-like length are observed

gates.scope: Any method depending on non-primitive native types
gates.reason: Documented types and C++ declarations do not prove Python constructibility or serialization.
required_evidence: Allowlisted loaded-module metadata
Exact Python type factory/fields, no opaque str fallback
Separate bounded native conversion test if approved

gates.reason: Bool/int overloads and current-colorway/face scope must not be silently selected by SDK coercion.
required_evidence: Explicit overload signature and enum meanings
Fresh pattern/fabric/current-colorway guards
Independent assignment/color readback in same context

gates.reason: One-argument setter applies a different scope than per-avatar setter; do not substitute.
required_evidence: Fresh avatar identity
Explicit per-avatar overload
Getter observation plus visual confirmation; unaffected avatars unchanged

gates.reason: Format, add/replace behavior, dialogs and option type bindings differ; no fallback overload after a native effect.
required_evidence: Selected read-only input asset
Exact documented format and option binding
Explicit initial scene and observed add/replace semantics
No size/pose dialog claim until real check

gates.reason: List of bound records is not validated JSON; stringification does not preserve a contract.
required_evidence: Public documented fields and units
Bounded typed serialization
Missing fields reported as unsupported, not success text

gates.reason: Copy option and material links need semantic review; indices/current context invalidate on mutation.
required_evidence: Copy enum values from official source
Fresh unique target names/current context
Independent exact list/current-index readback
No final-item deletion until explicit policy

gates.reason: Full pattern indices, real-pattern indices, component indices and returned child indices are not interchangeable.
required_evidence: Namespace and coordinate frame mapping
Getter topology fixture before mutations
Explicit child identity and unaffected-piece checks

gates.reason: Partial result 0 means success, not false; full-group docs have return contradictions. Return is not sufficient topology verification.
required_evidence: Reviewed return status enum
Resolved documentation contradiction or explicit blocked overload
Known line pairs/direction/ranges and connectivity readback
User visual confirmation

gates.scope: Point movement on disposable dedicated fixture
gates.reason: Donor reported corruption; changelog fix does not constitute local acceptance.
required_evidence: Exact build and argument semantics
Before/after full topology and independent geometry
Explicit dedicated real test approval; no normal workflow inclusion before acceptance

gates.reason: Bool return does not prove correct drape; output-list binding may not expose useful data; client timeout does not stop native simulation.
required_evidence: Valid prepared garment and avatar
Proven getter or explicitly visual acceptance
Bounded requested work and no native-cancellation promise
No auto Stop or cleanup on timeout

gates.reason: Some overloads open dialogs; path plus ExportDxfOption is documented differently and requires a constructible Python option record.
required_evidence: Exact no-dialog overload and type fields
Selected new output path, no overwrite
Artifact and related-file verification

gates.reason: Stream naming does not prove read-only operation; associated images/output folder may be written.
required_evidence: Side-effect and option review
Dedicated output folder
Bounded output manifest, no partial output deletion after failure

gates.reason: Donor reports scene replacement; do not promise append or use as hidden fixture setup.
required_evidence: Explicit destructive scene scope
Input structure and documented semantics
Independent whole-scene identity/topology comparison

gates.reason: Old getter was removed; new buffer getters and std::array caster are not interchangeable accepted contracts.
required_evidence: Removed status and current signatures retained separately
Python caster/shape/units check
Nesting fixture and quality invariants

gates.scope: REST/auth/cloud, GUI/plugin/widget/script registration, application lifecycle and global environment
gates.reason: Full inventory is not permission for network transfer, arbitrary execution, UI automation, dependency installs or closing applications.
required_evidence: Explicit operation-level authorization
No secrets in reports
Separate security/lifecycle contract and acceptance plan
